label: Leader as Fear Fades, Bear Market
about: The fear-fade entry (VIX falling hard over three days) applied under the 200-day: when panic drains out of a bear market, leaders still above their own 200-day lead the relief rally. Buy near the close; take profits at 2 ATR or the 7-day high.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (bear-market research, Nov 14 2026)

label: ETF Washout in a Bear Market
about: Index and sector ETFs cannot go to zero the way a stock can, so their washouts in bear markets have snapped back more reliably than single stocks. An unleveraged ETF with RSI(2) under 10 that closes near its low while SPY is under its 200-day; buy a little under the close, sell on a close above the prior day's high.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (bear-market research, Nov 14 2026)

label: Sharp Correction Panic, Early in a Bear
about: Early in a break below the 200-day (the first weeks), a 3%+ market drop in a week has usually been a correction that snapped back; deep into a bear market the same drop kept falling. Buy a leader above its own 200-day that closes weak on such a day, only while the break is young.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (bear-market research, Nov 14 2026)

label: Pullback inside a Bear-Market Rally
about: Bear markets have strong rallies. When SPY is under its 200-day but back above its 50-day, the short-term trend is up: buy a leader above its own 50-day on a short-term oversold reading; sell at the 5-day average.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (bear-market research, Nov 14 2026)

label: Bear-Market Leader, Oversold
about: While SPY is under its 200-day, the few stocks still in their own uptrend (above a rising 200-day, top relative strength) are where buyers return first. Buy one when it is short-term oversold, a little under the close; sell at the 5-day average.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (bear-market research, Nov 14 2026)

label: Aged Bear, Confirmed Bounce in a Leader
about: Deep into a bear market, buying weakness fails; waiting for strength works better. A relative-strength leader that was oversold yesterday and closes above yesterday's high today has buyers in control. Buy near the close; take profits at 2 ATR or the 7-day high.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (bear-market research, Nov 14 2026)

label: Low-Volatility Uptrend Dip in a Bear Market
about: In bear markets money hides in quiet, steady stocks. A low-volatility stock above its rising 200-day that gets short-term oversold while SPY is under its 200-day; buy a little under the close, sell at the 5-day average.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (bear-market research, Nov 14 2026)
Swing Desk own design (2026-11-16)

label: High-Capture Stock Washed Out under the 200-Day
about: Own design from the Nov 16 ticker study, wider: any day SPY is under its 200-day average, calm or stressed.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-16)

label: High-Beta Leader Washed Out in a Bear Selloff
about: Own design from the Nov 16 ticker study. The same effect on stronger names: a high-beta stock that is still stronger than most, oversold in a bear-market selloff.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-16)

label: High-Capture Stock Washed Out in a Bear Selloff
about: Own design from the Nov 16 ticker study. In bear-market selloffs the stocks that fall hardest with the market also bounce hardest: buy a deeply oversold stock whose downside capture is high, sell on the bounce to its 5-day average.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-16)

label: High-Capture ETF Closing Weak under the 200-Day
about: Own design from the Nov 16 ticker study. The same effect in ETFs, bought at the close: an unleveraged ETF that falls harder than the market, closing near its low while SPY is under its 200-day average.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-16)

label: High-Capture Leader in a Bull-Market Pullback
about: Own design from the Nov 16 ticker study. Tests whether the bear-selloff effect carries into pullbacks in a bull market for the strongest stocks: a leader that falls harder than the market on bad days, deeply oversold while the market is stressed above its 200-day average.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-16)

label: In-Play Leader Pauses after a Dip, Calm Bull Market
about: Own design from the Nov 16 attention study. After a short dip a high-attention leader prints an inside day in a calm bull market: selling has paused. Buy the next session at the close price, sell at the 5-day average.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-17)

label: Leader Dip into the Turn of the Month, Calm Bull Market
about: Own design for quiet weeks (Nov 17). In the last sessions of the month, in a calm bull market, a relative-strength leader above its 50-day average closes down with a low RSI(2). Month-end buying tends to lift it within days: the same dip on other days of the month won 7 to 9 points less often in both test periods. Buy near the close, sell at the 5-day average.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-17)

label: Leader Closes Weak into the Turn of the Month, Calm Bull Market
about: Own design for quiet weeks (Nov 17). In the last two sessions of the month, in a calm bull market, a relative-strength leader above its 50-day average closes down, in the lower part of the day's range, with a low RSI(2). Month-end buying tends to lift it within days: the same dip on other days of the month won 7 to 9 points less often in both test periods. Buy near the close, sell at the 5-day average.

label: Leader when Few Stocks Hold Their 50-Day, Reward Equal to Risk
about: Own design (Nov 17). Fewer than 15% of stocks are above their 50-day average: a washed-out market. A leader above its 200-day average is oversold. Stop 2 ATR, target 2 ATR, no early exit.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-17, reward at least the risk)

label: Leader in a Crash Week, Reward Equal to Risk
about: Own design (Nov 17). The market has fallen hard in a week; a relative-strength leader still above its 200-day average is deeply oversold. Buy a little under the close, stop 2 ATR below, target 2 ATR above, no early exit: the snap-back after forced selling travels far enough that the reward is as large as the risk.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-17, reward at least the risk)

label: Leader on a Fear Spike, Reward Equal to Risk
about: Own design (Nov 17). Fear is far above normal (VIX well above its 20-day average) and the market is down on the week; a leader above its 200-day average is oversold. Stop 2 ATR, target 2 ATR, no early exit.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-17, reward at least the risk)

label: ETF in a Crash Week, Reward Equal to Risk
about: Own design (Nov 17). The market has fallen hard in a week and an unleveraged ETF is deeply oversold. Buy near the close, stop 2 ATR below, target 2 ATR above, no early exit.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-17, reward at least the risk)

label: Gap Up that Holds on Heavy Volume, Target Twice the Risk
about: Own design (Nov 18, 2026). A stock gaps above the prior day's high (usually news or earnings) on at least {v}x normal volume and closes in the top part of the day's range, above its open: buyers kept the gap. Buy near the close, stop just under the day's low, target {m} times that risk. A gap that holds its first day tends to keep drifting for weeks.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-17, reward at least the risk)

label: Strong Stock's Quiet Pullback to the 20-Day EMA, Room to the High
about: Own design (Nov 18, 2026). A stock up 25%+ in three months pulls back quietly (volume under its average) and closes just above its 20-day EMA, with the 20-day high at least twice as far above as the EMA is below. Buy near the close, stop 0.5 ATR under the EMA, target the 20-day high: the reward is at least twice the risk by construction.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-17, reward at least the risk)

label: Capitulation Volume Reversal off a 20-Day Low, Target Twice the Risk
about: Own design (Nov 18, 2026). A stock above its 200-day average makes a new 20-day low on {v}x normal volume, then closes in the top half of the day's range: forced selling met a buyer. Buy near the close, stop just under the day's low, target {m} times that risk.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-17, reward at least the risk)

label: Bullish Outside Day at the 50-Day in an Uptrend, Target Twice the Risk
about: Own design (Nov 18, 2026). In an uptrend (50-day above 200-day), a stock trades below the prior day's low and under its 50-day average, then closes above the prior day's high and back above the 50-day: a one-day reversal at support. Buy near the close, stop just under the day's low, target {m} times that risk.

source.title: Swing Desk own design (2026-11-17, reward at least the risk)

label: ETF Bullish Outside Day after a Market Selloff, Target Twice the Risk
about: Own design (Nov 18, 2026). After the market has fallen (SPY down 3%+ in a week), an unleveraged ETF trades below the prior day's low and then closes above the prior day's high: sellers exhausted. Buy near the close, stop just under the day's low, target {m} times that risk.
